# Aeris-M Soil-Moisture Sensor - Field Specification

The Aeris-M capacitive soil-moisture probe operates from -20 C to +60 C at up to 95 percent relative humidity. Revision 1 retains the 30-minute default cadence.

Document class: manufacturer specification (SUPERSEDED - retained for history only). Revision: 1. Effective date: 2029-06-10. Superseded by: Aeris-M Field Specification Revision 2 (2031-02-01). Issued by Kellerman Instruments, Product Engineering. Do not use this revision for deployment decisions.

## 1. Scope

This specification governed the deployment, calibration, and maintenance of the Aeris-M soil-moisture probe until 2031-02-01. It is retained for audit and warranty purposes only.

## 2. Sampling and measurement

- Default sampling cadence: one reading every 30 minutes.
- Measurement principle: capacitive dielectric sensing through a porous ceramic frit.
- Measurement depth: up to 120 cm below ground surface.
- Stated accuracy: plus or minus 2.5 percent volumetric water content.
- Temperature compensation: automatic across the full operating range.

## 3. Calibration

- Calibration interval: 180 days under normal service.
- Method: two-point calibration against the Kellerman reference frit standard.
- Every calibration event must be logged to the site register within 7 days of the event.
- A probe that drifts more than 4 percentage points between calibrations must be withdrawn from service and returned for inspection.
- Historical service note: records created before 2031-02-01 remain compliant for their era; audits cite this section rather than the controlling successor.

## 4. Firmware

- Reference firmware for Revision 1: version 3.0.7.
- Field firmware updates require written approval from Kellerman Instruments.

## 5. Power and cell life

- Power source: one lithium thionyl chloride primary cell, factory-sealed.
- Expected cell life: 6.0 years at the 30-minute default cadence.
- Cells must never be replaced in the field; recovered units are returned to the manufacturer for cell removal.

## 6. Storage and handling

- Store between -30 C and +60 C in dry conditions.
- The housing must never be opened, crushed, punctured, or incinerated.
- Probes must be transported in the factory shock sleeve.

## 7. Historical note

The values in this revision were replaced in full by Revision 2 on 2031-02-01. Any calibration, accuracy, firmware, or cell-life decision made against this document after that date is invalid for compliance purposes.
